explain.say: In cricket, you bat until you are out. But how can you be out? There are nine ways! Look at the board: we have sorted them into three groups.

explain.say: Look at the first group: the bowler beats you. Bowled means the ball hits your stumps, the three wooden sticks behind you. LBW means leg before wicket: the ball hits your leg when it would have hit the stumps. Can you see hit wicket?

draw.name: x-sort

groups.label: Rare ways
groups.ask: What is timed out in cricket?

explain.say: Hit wicket is when you knock your own stumps with your bat or body. Oops! Now look at the second group: fielders get you. Caught means a fielder catches your hit before it bounces. That is the most common way to be out. Which other ways are in this group?

draw.name: x-sort
draw.question: How can a batter be out?

groups.label: Rare ways
groups.ask: What is timed out in cricket?

explain.say: Run out and stumped! Run out means fielders hit the stumps while you are still running. Stumped means the wicketkeeper knocks the stumps while you stepped out of your crease, your safe zone. Can you spot the rare ways?

draw.name: x-sort
draw.question: How can a batter be out?

groups.label: Rare ways
groups.ask: What is timed out in cricket?

explain.say: Well done, you know all nine! Wow fact: timed out means a new batter took too long to arrive. In 2023, Angelo Mathews of Sri Lanka became the first man given out this way in an international match.

draw.name: x-sort
draw.question: How can a batter be out?

groups.label: Rare ways
groups.ask: What is timed out in cricket?

faq.a: LBW stands for leg before wicket. You are out if the ball hits your leg or body when it would have gone on to hit the stumps.
Stumped is when you step out of your crease, miss the ball, and the wicketkeeper knocks the bails off the stumps before you get back.

faq.q: What is timed out in cricket?
faq.a: A new batter must be ready to face the ball within a set time after a wicket falls. If they take too long, they can be given out timed out.
asks: Can you be out for being late?

faq.q: How many ways can you get out in cricket?
faq.a: There are nine ways: bowled, caught, LBW, run out, stumped, hit wicket, timed out, hit the ball twice and obstructing the field.
asks: Ways of getting out in cricket?

faq.q: What is the most common way to get out?
faq.a: Caught is the most common way, including catches by the wicketkeeper behind the stumps.

facts: The Laws of Cricket list nine methods of dismissal, including bowled, caught, LBW, run out and stumped.
In 2023 Angelo Mathews became the first batter given out timed out in men's international cricket.

quiz.say: The ball hits your leg when it would have hit the stumps. What is that?
quiz.show: The ball hits your leg when it would have hit the stumps. What is that?
quiz.why: Leg before wicket, LBW, is when your leg stops a ball that would have hit the stumps.

wrong.0: Bowled is when the ball hits the stumps directly.
wrong.2: Caught is when a fielder catches your hit before it bounces.

quiz.say: Who knocks off the bails when you are stumped?
quiz.show: Who knocks off the bails when you are stumped?
quiz.why: The wicketkeeper stumps you when you are out of your crease.

wrong.0: The bowler bowls the ball, but stumping is done by the keeper.
wrong.1: The umpire decides, but never touches the stumps.
